help.title: FAQ Operations Help
help.description: A step-by-step guide to writing FAQs and improving search quality across FAQ List, Create FAQ, and FAQ Quality.
help.scoreReading: How to Read FAQ Search Scores

advanced.title: Vector and Hybrid FAQ Search Guide
advanced.description: FAQ answer lookup keeps the existing keyword-weighted method as the default. Vector search and LLM ID selection are optional accuracy boosters, so they should be enabled only for the workspaces or test cases that need them.

prepare.title: 1. Prepare vectors and hints in FAQ Quality
prepare.alt: FAQ Quality screen showing rebuild vectors, suggest hints, and retrieval mode controls
prepare.summary: Keyword, shared-term expansion, and vector search work together, while LLM ID selection remains optional.

bullets.0: Rebuild Vectors combines answer titles, summaries, selected body text, tags, and finding hints into answer-level search vectors.
bullets.1: Run Find terms with AI under Terms & Aliases to discover synonym, abbreviation, and new-expression candidates from FAQs and unmatched questions. Only approved candidates affect search.
bullets.2: Retrieval mode is split into Keyword, Keyword + Vector, and LLM ID Select. Keyword + Vector is the default for handling wording differences.

prepare.note: After bulk answer imports or large finding hint edits, rebuild vectors first and then run hybrid tests for more stable results.

hybrid.title: 2. Interpret Keyword + Vector results
hybrid.alt: FAQ Quality showing a Keyword + Vector lookup result and candidate score details
hybrid.summary: Hybrid mode ranks candidates by combining the existing keyword score with semantic similarity.

bullets.0: keyword_score is the existing weighted score from representative questions, keywords, synonyms, title, body, and tags.
bullets.1: vector_score is semantic similarity between the query and answer vector. It helps with different wording such as “SIM replacement”.
bullets.2: hybrid_score is the final score. Review keyword_score, vector_score, and hybrid_score together on the candidate cards.

hybrid.note: If selected_by is vector, semantic similarity had a stronger effect on the selected candidate. If that result is wrong, adjust negative terms and representative questions before adding more synonyms.

llm.title: 3. Use LLM ID Select as the final check
llm.alt: FAQ Quality showing LLM ID Select choosing only one candidate FAQ ID
llm.summary: LLM ID Select does not generate answer text. It is constrained to choose one answer ID from already retrieved candidates.

bullets.0: If the LLM returns an ID outside the candidate list, the server rejects it. This is not a generated-answer flow.
bullets.1: Because latency and cost are higher than keyword or vector lookup, use it for ambiguous questions instead of as the default for every request.
bullets.2: selected_by=llm_id_selector means the LLM chose the final ID from the candidate list.

llm.note: The recommended production flow is keyword-based answer item selection first, Keyword + Vector for wording differences, and LLM ID Select only when top candidates are close.

sources.guidanceCandidateWithoutPreviewDesc: Preview has not been run. Add manual hints here, or continue and the source will be analyzed automatically during creation.
sources.snapshotHistoryDesc: Review which source content created answer candidates, how it was mapped, and what stored snapshot is available for audit.
sources.noSnapshots: No FAQ creation history has been recorded yet.
sources.supportToolsDesc: Use this setup and history view when the same structured source, such as a DB table, CSV, or NoSQL collection, is reused or converted into many answer candidates.
sources.connectorRegistryDesc: This is not required for quick answer candidate creation. Register reusable input only when the same DB, NoSQL, web, or table input must be sampled and mapped repeatedly.
sources.connectorRelationshipDesc: Use this when, for example, a customer-service FAQ DB table must be read every week, or the same Excel/CSV column structure must be mapped repeatedly. For one or two manual answers, use Quick Add Answers only.
sources.connectorContentHelp: For DB table input, this can be left empty when the location is a readable db://schema.table value.
sources.connectorAuthRefHelp: To read another PostgreSQL database, enter the server environment variable containing its connection URL. Leave this empty to read a table from the LightRAG database.
sources.connectorSampleTruncated: The mapping preview shows the first {{limit}} rows. Creation reads up to 1,000 rows again and stops with an error if the table exceeds the batch limit.

sources.connectorContentRequired: Paste sample data before creating reusable input.
sources.connectorModeDataset: Whole table as one dataset answer candidate
sources.purposeFaqDesc: Return the answer body that matches the question.
sources.purposeIdLookupDesc: Search descriptive columns and return the selected business ID column.
sources.idLookupMappingDesc: Select the business ID to return and the details users can search.
sources.sampleValidationOnly: This check uses the preview sample. All rows are validated again when FAQs are created.
sources.repreviewAfterMapping: Run mapping preview again after changing fields to refresh validation.
sources.idLookupValidationFailed: Check the return ID and searchable detail columns before creating FAQs.
sources.sampleConnector: Load Sample into Quick Add Answers
sources.sampleLoaded: Reusable input sample has been loaded into the quick Add Answers editor.
sources.mappingPreviewReady: Reusable input mapping check is ready.
sources.materializeConnector: Create Answer Candidates from Reusable Input
sources.connectorMaterialized: {{count}} answer candidate(s) were created from the reusable input.
sources.connectorPreviewHint: Check the reusable input detected columns, answer mapping, and finding hint fields before creating answer candidates.
sources.guidanceColumnsHelp: Finding hint columns are added to each row as keyword hints. Columns already used as answer fields or policy fields are disabled.
sources.rowPerAnswerModeHelp: {{count}} answer candidate(s) will be created. An answer candidate is one unpublished answer that can be reviewed and published later.
sources.tableAsDatasetModeHelp: One dataset answer candidate will be created from the whole table. Use this when you want to query the table as structured data instead of creating FAQ answers per row.
sources.rowAnswerFieldsDesc: These mappings are applied row by row. One row becomes one answer candidate when row-per-answer mode is selected.
sources.rowPolicyFieldsDesc: Optional row-level policy mappings. If a column is not selected, every generated answer candidate is created as draft with no validity date.
sources.rowPreviewDesc: This preview shows how sample rows will become answer candidates. It does not create answers yet.
sources.rowPreviewHelp: Generated candidates are opened later in the Answers menu for individual review and publishing.
sources.excelHintsDesc: For Excel row-per-answer creation, finding hints are generated from the selected columns per row. Manual shared hints are not applied because they would be copied to every generated candidate.
sources.questionHintRule: Saved as a high-weight question hint for each row.
sources.titleHintRule: Also used as a keyword hint so short title searches can find the answer.
sources.categoryHintRule: Added as a tag and keyword hint for filtering and lookup.
sources.answerHintRule: Used as a low-weight note hint for context, not as a representative question.
sources.extraHintRule: Added as an additional keyword hint for each row.
sources.noExcelHintBasis: No finding hint columns are selected. Titles and answer bodies are still searchable. To cover more user phrasing, enable LLM bulk enrichment below or map representative question, category, or extra hint columns.
sources.excelHintsReviewHelp: After candidates are created, each candidate can still be edited in the Answers menu. Add answer-specific synonyms or exclusions there when needed.
sources.batchLlmEnable: Enrich row-level finding hints with LLM
sources.batchLlmEnableHelp: Unpublished FAQ candidates are created first, then only conversational questions, keywords, synonyms, and bilingual product aliases are added. Answer content is never generated or changed.
sources.batchLlmCoverage: Only FAQs with weak expression coverage (Recommended)
sources.batchLlmCoverageDesc: Enrich only FAQs lacking conversational questions, synonyms, or bilingual product expressions such as Teams and 팀즈.
sources.batchLlmWeakOnlyDesc: Enrich only FAQs missing a representative question or keyword/synonym.
sources.batchLlmAllDesc: Review and enrich every row. This gives wider coverage but uses more LLM calls.
sources.batchLlmEstimate: {{rows}} FAQs, up to {{calls}} LLM requests, and up to 5 additional hints per FAQ
sources.batchLlmEstimateCoverage: The actual request count can be lower because FAQs with sufficient question, synonym, and bilingual term coverage are skipped.
sources.batchLlmEstimateWeak: The actual request count can be lower because rows with sufficient hints are skipped.
sources.batchLlmTaskDesc: FAQ candidate creation is complete. Finding hints are being enriched in the background.
sources.vectorTaskDesc: FAQ creation is complete. Vectors are being prepared in the background so semantically similar questions can be found even when wording differs.

mappingRoleHelp.id: Reference value for tracing the source row. The answer ID is generated separately by the system.
mappingRoleHelp.title: Title shown in answer lists and lookup results.
mappingRoleHelp.question: A likely user question. Saved as the strongest finding hint.
mappingRoleHelp.answer: The actual answer body shown to users.
mappingRoleHelp.category: Used as a row-level tag and keyword hint.
mappingRoleHelp.status: Recognizes draft, published, archived, expired, and Korean equivalents.
mappingRoleHelp.valid_from: The answer can be used from this date.
mappingRoleHelp.valid_until: The answer can be used until this date.

matching.improvementQueueDesc: Select an FAQ that needs stronger search settings and review AI suggestions.
matching.compactHintSummary: Search settings: {{total}} total · {{questions}} questions · {{keywords}} keywords · {{synonyms}} synonyms · {{negatives}} exclusions
matching.title: Answer Item Settings
matching.description: Manage representative questions, keywords, synonyms, exclusion terms, graph-based hints, and optional LLM suggestions so the right answer item can be selected.

matching.addRequired: Select an answer and enter finding hint text.
matching.vectorRebuilt: {{count}} answer vectors were rebuilt. {{remaining}} answers remain.
matching.quickTestDescription: After editing representative questions, keywords, or exclusions, verify which answer is selected by the current settings.
matching.testDockDescription: Verify the selected answer from the current settings without leaving this screen.
matching.testResultDescription: Shows which answer the current finding hints selected for the test question.
matching.answerExplorerDesc: Find an answer first, then edit only that answer’s finding hints.
matching.answerSearch: Search title, body, tag, or finding hint...
matching.noAnswers: No answers match the current filters.
matching.aliasDescription: Register product names, abbreviations, and bilingual expressions once for all FAQs. For example, a query containing 팀즈 can match FAQs containing Microsoft Teams.
matching.aiTermCandidatesDescription: AI reviews FAQs and unmatched questions to suggest synonyms, abbreviations, and new expressions. Only approved candidates affect FAQ search.
matching.termDiscoveryStarted: AI term analysis started. Review the candidates when it finishes.
matching.termDiscoveryCompleted: AI term analysis is complete. Review the suggested candidates.
matching.noTermCandidates: No term candidates are waiting for review. Run AI term discovery or register a term directly.
matching.noTermCandidateHistory: No term candidates exist for this status.
matching.termCandidateApproved: The approved term group is now used for FAQ search.
matching.manualTermRegistrationDescription: Use this when the standard term and aliases are already known.
matching.aliasRequired: Enter a standard term and at least one alias.
matching.selectedGuidanceDesc: Only hints connected to the selected answer are shown here.
matching.noUnguided: No answers are missing finding hints.

structured.description: Analyze DB, NoSQL, and table sources so they can be searched safely with fixed conditions.
structured.empty: No tabular dataset is connected. Analyze table data above, then create a dataset or FAQs.

analytics.description: Review answer usage, no-answer outcomes, retrieval modes, and source-based activity.

analytics.topQueriesDesc: Grouped by identical user query text.
analytics.sourceGroupsDesc: Grouped by the source type of the selected answer.
analytics.modeGroupsDesc: Grouped by the actual retrieval mode: keyword, keyword + vector, or LLM ID select.
analytics.dailyGroupsDesc: Groups event create_time by date in {{timezone}}.
analytics.hourlyGroupsDesc: Groups event create_time by hour in {{timezone}}.
analytics.timeBasis: Date and hour groups use event create_time converted to {{timezone}}.
analytics.reportSummaryDesc: Select a report row to show answer item selection events on the right.
analytics.allEventsDesc: All events for the current global filters.
analytics.drilldownDesc: Showing events for this report row out of {{count}} events.
analytics.candidatesDesc: Candidates are sorted by final score. Review the main evidence first and expand technical scores only when needed.

reason.scoreOnly: This candidate has a final score but no detailed evidence.
reason.noSignal: There is little direct evidence connecting this answer to the query.
reason.title: The user query is strongly connected to the answer title.
reason.guidance: Registered representative questions or keywords match the user query well.
reason.vector: The wording differs, but semantic similarity strengthened this candidate.
reason.metadata: Tags or category information partially overlap with the query.
reason.partial: Some words in the body or summary overlap with the query.

detailedAnalytics.eventListDesc: Events matching the current filters and selected report view.

detailedAnalytics.queryViewDesc: Track repeated, surging, or failed user queries.

detailedAnalytics.modeViewDesc: Compare usage and outcomes across keyword, vector, and LLM ID selection.
